column3: MT 85:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. NASB sets the title in braces before verse 1. Close to the Hebrew; “You turned back the captivity” is rendered “You restored the captivity.”
Close to the Hebrew; “break Your anger with us” is rendered “cause Your indignation toward us to cease.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Will You return, revive us” is rendered “revive us again.”
Close to the Hebrew; “and to His faithful ones” is rendered “to His godly ones.”
Close to the Hebrew; “faithfulness” is rendered “truth.”
Close to the Hebrew; “faithfulness” is rendered “Truth.”
The Hebrew is compressed (“will set for a way His footsteps”); NASB renders “will make His footsteps into a way.”
